text.p: Thermatrix Inc said Tuesday it expects to report a second quarter loss of between $0.29 a share and $0.31 a share.
The company said in a statement it expects revenues for he quarter, ended June 30, will be about double its first quarter revenues of $1.1 million.
Analysts had expected the company would earn $0.18 a share for the second quarter, according to First Call.

Operating expenses for the second quarter are expected to be higher than in the first quarter primarily due to increased spending for research and development activities relating to emerging business opportunities and the costs associated with the staffing, training and relocation of the company's European operations center.
The company said its backlog indicates that revenues will also increase in the third quarter.
